name: ajitta
description: ajitta's Claude Code plugins, side by side. A catalog only: each plugin also serves itself from its own repository, which is the recommended install.

plugins.name: game-engagement-retention
plugins.description: Three routed skills for designing in-session reward moments and lifecycle retention for games and consumer interactive apps — the scene, the cohort, and the link between them.

plugins.name: unknowns
plugins.description: Know your unknowns — skills for the gap between your plan and the actual situation, in any domain: what you don't know, what the AI doesn't, and what neither knows yet. Eleven skills: blind-spot passes, field primers, interviews, divergent prototypes, brainstorming, reference read-backs, tweakable plans, a deviation log, buy-in docs and quizzes — plus two Claude Code agents.

plugins.name: dia
plugins.description: Thirteen reasoning-and-review skills plus the dia router: goal confirmation (skopos), Socratic elenchus and inquiry (quaestio), reductio, internal critique, argument warrants, counterexamples, counterplans, a single review pass (emend), verification-gated rounds, adjudicating review reports, rules for text a model follows (regula), and deepening a request as a field's top practitioners would; a skill starts when the message begins with dia or its name.
